text:
tamara_ae: NimbusPay POC request landed. They require BYO-HSM (Luna certified), non-exportable keys, daily rotation proofs for high-risk keys, cross-region key-hash mirroring (digest-only), and auditor retention of rotation proofs for 7 years. Asking for a 3-day dry-run next week. Need feasibility + pricing delta. cc @ashish_se @rachel_security

ashish_se: Quick clarifying q: cross-region mirroring: they want only digests (no key material) replicated to our backup region for verification, or they want synchronized partial-sign processes? Also confirm whether they accept PKCS#11 or KMIP. Network model?

tamara_ae: They said "digest-only" for mirror, PKCS#11 vendor shim preferred, and proxy must live in their VPC (no inbound). Custodians will use time-based OTP for manual rotation approvals.

rachel_security: Security checklist: FIPS 140-2 cert for HSM, firmware attestation report, custodian MFA + OTP audit trail, immutable rotation proofs anchored to an internal log + optional public anchor, and 7-year retention. Blocker: long retention may have export/privacy implications. We need legal to sign off on retention policy.

henry_ops: Implementation notes: we'll deploy a staging-proxy in their VPC that mTLSs to their HSM. For digest mirroring we can push SHA256 manifest to our secondary region storage; manifest must never include key material. For daily rotation we can provide either manual (custodian-run) or automated orchestration. For POC, manual + signed proof acceptable. Need vendor .so and a test admin account.

tamara_ae: Procurement asks how to bill the cross-region mirror and retention storage. They want a flat monthly fee if possible.

jobs_bot: deployer: created staging-proxy in customer-vpc (us-central-1) at 2026-10-05T02:14Z

ashish_se: Pricing recommendation: (1) small POC flat fee (attestation + dry-run), (2) a BYO-HSM enterprise premium, (3) reserved throughput monthly for signing capacity, (4) optional add-on for long-term rotation-proof archival (monthly per-GB or fixed bucket), (5) optional public-anchor bundle (per-TX or monthly bucket). For predictable billing offer a retention bundle covering 7-year compliance at a fixed yearly price.

rachel_security: For the security questionnaire we'll prepare answers: confirm no-key-export, show manifest schema (example below), describe custodian OTP flow, and provide sample audit entries. Also note: notarized firmware attestation is extra.

ashish_se: Example manifest (we never include key material):

"manifest_id:nimbus-rot-20261005;key_id:nm-highrisk-1;tenant:nimbus-pay;rotated_at:2026-10-05T08:00:00Z;rotated_by:alice_custodian;proof_sig:rsa:BASE64SIG"

rachel_security: Sample audit line we'll use in runbook: ```
2026-10-05T08:00:12Z INFO rotation manifest_id=nimbus-rot-20261005 key_id=nm-highrisk-1 tenant=nimbus-pay proof_hash=sha256:8f3a2c... stored_region=us-west-2 retention=7y notarized=false
```

henry_ops: For the PKCS#11 shim some vendor modules require privileged containers. For staging we can run a privileged task, but production might need a hardware-backed host. Potential blocker: customer policy may not allow privileged containers in their VPC. Ask them whether a vendor-supplied sidecar is acceptable.

tamara_ae: Customer legal flagged the 7-year retention as needing a data-processor addendum. I'll loop in legal. Also they asked whether we can produce daily rotation proof pushed to their auditor webhook and an additional hashed mirror on public testnet for independent verification.

rachel_security: We can support pushing the manifest to their auditor webhook. Public testnet anchoring is optional; we'd treat it as an add-on with per-TX gas pass-through. For POC we'll include 3 testnet anchors.

ashish_se: Technical POC plan: Day 0 - get vendor PKCS#11 .so, admin creds, IP allowlist, and OTP custodian contacts. Day 1 - deploy staging-proxy, validate PKCS#11 calls and return signatures, Day 2 - run manual rotation flow with custodian OTP and capture proofs, Day 3 - run perf and mirroring tests. Deliverables: runbook, attestation doc (internal), perf report, audit artifacts, and optional 3 testnet anchors.

henry_ops: Sample curl to hit staging proxy (returns signature blob and manifest id):

```
curl -X POST https://staging-proxy.nimbus.internal/sign \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer POCTOKEN' \
  -d '{"key_id":"nm-highrisk-1","payload":"...base64..."}'
```

response will include manifest_id we can then anchor or mirror.

tamara_ae: They requested daily rotation within 24h window for high-risk keys; for POC they accept a manual rotation by custodian with OTP. Also asked for evidence we never log key or key material.

rachel_security: We'll include CI grep rules and a log retention policy. Also add a sample grep rule to runbook: `grep -E "key=|key_material=|private_key" --invert-match` in log pipelines and fail pipeline on match.

henry_ops: Action items: 1) @tamara_ae collect vendor .so + admin test creds + allowlist + auditor webhook, 2) @rachel_security produce Q&A and runbook snippet, 3) @ashish_se prepare ephemeral cert rotation docs and OTP integration guide, 4) ops to size the mirror storage and retention bucket quote. Aim: run dry-run next Tue 09:00 PST.

tamara_ae: I'll get vendor files today and update timeline. Thanks team :thumbsup:
